name: Chamonix
description:
Up the 1st stage of Le Brevent cable car.

PLEASE NOTE: TOP LANDING IS NOT ALLOWED.

Planpraz (S/SSW) 2040m, easy, for PG and HG,
GPS: 45°56’11.76”N, 6°51’4.46”E
You pass under the free-hanging cable to Brévent
on the right (its highest side).

Planpraz (Aiguilles Rouges side) is good in the
morning until early afternoon. The house thermals
are in front of you and later more in the gully below
Brévent. To the left in front of takeoff there are the
Brevent cable car cables. Keep right and pass under
the cables with a good safety margin. Overflying the
highest ridge to the right (W/NW) of launch at less
than 1,000m above ground level is forbidden! N or
W winds stronger than 20km/h at 2000m will cause
a leeside situation: expect strong, turbulent conditions.
For XC flights towards the Flégère, beware of
the horizontal cables of the Brevent–Flégère cable
car in the Combe Lachenal at approx 1,700m!

Main Landing: Bois du Bouchet

Weather link: http://www.compagniedumontblanc.fr/fr/meteo

Webcamera: http://www.chamonet.com/chamonix/webcams/brevent-planpraz.html

However, pilots should have good wing control and be aware of potential dust devils on thermic days. It is known as “Tom’s start” because Tom, the designer from Little Cloud, often uses it.

Landing zone in the valley.

Alternative to Haut Montet when the mistral is not too strong. 

Altitude restriction with max height of 2000 meters asl, due to Nice Cote de Azur airport.

name: Gourdon, Le Haut Montet
description:
Northwest of Nice by Gourdon.

Gourdon
1. l’Embarnier (S) 1105m, medium, main takeoff for HG & PG, but risk of rotor from the promontory rocks when the wind is stronger! 
GPS: 43°43’32.01”N, 6°56’49.65”E.  

2. l’Embarnier (S/SW) 1160m, easy, big even slope
GPS:43°43’26.52”N, 6°56’38.23”E

3. Col de Cavillore (S/SE) 1030m, easy-medium,
GPS: 43°43’49.35”N, 6°58’20.30”E.

Altitude restrictions due Nice airport. Max altitude 2000 asl. Not allowed to fly XC down to the sea.

Thermals year around. Best conditions in winter. Very reliable flying weather in general.

Gourdon is usually protected from west wind but it can be turbulent if you fly too high as breeze (SSE) and real wind (W) cross each other in different directions.
A good idea is to check the wind at Lachens mountain as it is very exposed to the NW wind (mistral).

In winter the best thermal activity is located in the loup valley: Gourdon village, Kennedy and Courmettes. Usual XC flights are: Gourdon - Observatoire - Grasse and/or Gourdon - Village - Courmette, Tourette sur loup, Saint-Jannet (with return).
In summer people don't usually fly in the loup valley as the breeze is too strong and does not let you reach the landing field at Vallettes. Also the thermal house at the village can be rough. There is a much higher potential for XC at col de bleyne or saint-andre les alpes in summer.

Landing:
1. Domaine de St. Ambroise (830m) big field in
the valley below the plateau. 
GPS: 43°43’33.54”N,6°57’34.44”E. 

2. Landing Cavillore (851m) very small field.
GPS: 43°43’37.74”N, 6°58’8.64”E.

3. Rives du Loup (175m) big field below the road, landing for all Gourdon takeoffs. HG & PG.
GPS: 43°42’0.57”N, 7° 0’20.45”E.

The official landing field is below the parking place at Cavillore (read info at take-off). Easy top landing on the back. The landing field in the loup valley is the obvious huge field at the very end and it's a long way to glide to so be careful. Please don't get it wrong: it's strictly forbidden to land at any other place, the site is threatened to be closed, two take-off have already been banned at Tourette and Courmette.

There is a bus every day but Sunday going from Vallettes to Gourdon for 1 euro, check time schedule at www.envibus.fr

GPS coordinates are for the village (landing).
Orienation: South, 300m to 1000m top to bottom. 
Access: Get a lift up in the paragliding school's 4WD, cost 30ff, or else walking to the lowest take-off takes 30 
minutes. 
Good dynamic soaring site mixed with thermals, and out and return possibilities. Very easy take-off and 
landing.

name: Laragne, Chabre
description:
Hovedstarten ved Laragne. Koordinaten er for toppen av veien merket med veiskilt til Chabre-Larange (eller Larange Chabre). Kjør inn til Chateauneuf de Chabre, derfra er det skiltet med 'Voile Libre' En rekke starter som ligger langs ridgen innen av avstand av ca. 500 meter. Alle startene ligger ved veien. Fineste starten for S og N er på toppen, noen minutters gåtur fra enden av veien. Ved lite vind er det vistnok mulig å start uansett vindretning. Startene i seg selv vender både mot S og N.

Launch
1. (N/S) 1265m, medium, 
GPS: 44°18’11.94”N, 5°46’36.67”E. 
On the right where the access road reaches the long Chabre ridge. Not good in the
afternoon. Not recommended for PG!

2. Les Espranons (S) 1285m, easy, MAIN Launch for PG and HG below the road. Don’t launch above
the road with stronger winds as the N side here is a vertical cliff! 
GPS: 44°17’55.24”N, 5°45’59.92”E.

3. (S/SW) easy, and (N) medium-difficult, 1354m, W of the end of the road, towards the highest point.
Best launch in the afternoon. N launch only suitable for good pilots! 
GPS: 44°17’52.10”N, 5°45’48.53”E.

Landing:
1. North, L’Île d’Oriane (565m) 
GPS: 44°19’12.08”N, 5°47’33.33”E. 
Drive to the big supermarket in Laragne. Follow the signs (opposite) for Air d’atterisage for about 1 km on a dead-end road to the industrial zone.

2. Laragne-Montéglin campsite(570m) 
GPS: 44°18’45.32”N, 5°50’2.20”E.
The main landing zone for HG and good PG pilots (glide ratio of 10 required!) easy to find, E of the railway line, 1 km SE of Laragne town centre.

3. PG south & emergency, Chabre(980m) 
GPS: 44°17’23.74”N, 5°46’2.53”E,
a bit narrow and uneven, surrounded by forest, signed on the way to takeoff.

4. South main landing (735m) PG & HG. 
GPS: 44°16’46.54”N, 5°46’30.25”E.
Good size field but surrounded by forest, right of the road to launch (signed).

5. Barret-sur-Méouge (650m) HG&PG, just before the entrance of the village, left of the D942 Chateauneuf–Séderon.
GPS: 44°15’45.13”N, 5°44’28.18”E

name: Monaco, Monte Carlo, Mont Gros
description:
Launch
1. Mont Gros (S-W) 677m, easy-medium, dome with a perfectly arranged green carpet. Crosswind makes it tricky for pilots with little experience as the launch ends in steep scree slope! 
GPS: 43°45’55.69”N, 7°26’33.55”E

2. Mont Gros (E/SE) 660m, medium, short flat slope, surrounded by bush, you need good headwind and launch skill! 
GPS: 43°45’58.31”N, 7°26’36.29”E

3. Laï Barraï (SE-SSW) 695m, medium, grassy dome, expert launch.
GPS: 43°45’21.38”N, 7°24’38.57”E.

Landing
Plage du Golf Bleu (0m) beach. GPS: 43 45’32.97”N, 7°27’18.48”E.

Flying
The site is open as follows: 16 November–30 April(no limitation); 1 May–30 June, 1 September–30 September (before 08h00 and after 18h00); 10 October–15 November (after 11h15). 
The altitude limit is 1950m ASL as you are flying within the range of LR-R83, a flight prohibition zone above Mont Agel. 
No flying west of La Turbie or above Monaco! Check the detailed aerial chart at the Laï Barraï infoboard.

description:
Stor, ganske flat start over Moustiers Sainte-Marie. Landing på Saint Clair.

COURCHON(S) 940m, easy, toplandable at Venascle. 
GPS:43°50’35.16”N, 6°13’48.90”E.
Access: Two possibilities: either park at the Moustiers graveyard and follow the path Chemin de Courchon on the upper end for about 1 hr. Or drive up to Venascle, pass the landing field and Gîte until you reach the junction with the piste to Montdenier at the windsock. Turn right instead towards the limit of the plateau, and the launch site.

Landing
1. Venascle (934m) the field on the mountainside in front of the Gîte de Venascle. 
GPS: 43°50’44.00”N, 6°15’6.00”E. 
Follow the D952 from Moustiers towards Riez/Puimoisson and after 3km turn right to Venascle, passing the campsite. After 200m turn left to the parking and landing.

name: Plan de l'Aiguille
description:
Beware of the electic line and the cables of the cable car.

Landing : Chamonix, Bois-du-Bouchet. Near the little lake.

Going there : 	Highway to Chamonix. There's a parking at the cable car station. Take the cable car to the intermediate station (Plan de l'Aiguille) ~ 20 EUROS for a one day special pass for paragliding. 

From the landing, you can reach the cable car lower station (where you just let your car, remember?) by foot, ~15mn.

Weather hazards : 	There are often _very_ strong thermal conditions. The wind can rise very quickly in the valley. Welcome to the mountains !

Flight regulation : 	It is not allowed to fly in July and August

People to contact : 	Club des Grattes-Ciel
http://www.lesgratteciel.org

Website : 	http://www.ffvl.fr/sites/sites.php3?id=74012

Il faut donc être prêt à abandonner dès que cela arrive, avant que tu as pris trop de vitesse.

name: Réunion, Maïdo
description:
"Det høye fjellet" - et fantastisk flott flysted.

Forholdsvis trang og flat stupstart (PP3) nær fjellet Maïdo. Avkjørsel fra Saint-Paul. Følg veien "Route de Maïdo" nesten til toppen. Gå stien opp siste stykket, ca 15-20 minutter, følg stien mot venstre når du kommer til inngjerding m/grind.

Det lønner seg å følge kanten til venstre for take-off for å sanke løft.

OBS! Flystedet kan være krevende pga trang dal som må passeres om en ikke får løft. Dalen kan være dekket av lavt skydekke, og det kan være kraftig dalvind. Det ene partiet kalles "La Machine à laver" - vaskemaskinen - ikke uten grunn.

Landing i elveleiet ned mot byen Saint-Paul (f.eks ved Lat 20.58.13,  Long 55.19.27). OBS! Mye stor stein mange steder i elveleiet.

name: St. André-Les-Alpes, Chalvet
description:
At good days the thermals lift at both sides, but will gradually go over to the west side of the mountain. 

Launch
1. (NE/E) 1546m, easy, flat dome, windsock, 
GPS: 43°58’38.88”N, 6°29’28.20”E

2. (S/SE) 1538m, easy, just a little lower before (1), grass slope with windsock.
GPS: 43°58’35.99”N, 6°29’28.89”E. 
Both (1) and(2) are toplandable!

3. (SW) 1552m, medium, steep slope, better for HG than PG, windsock on the edge above the summit road. 
GPS: 43°58’34.17”N, 6°28’54.07”E.

4. (W) 1554m, easy, excellent for PG, toplandable, windsocks, just N of the parking at the end of summit road. 
GPS: 43°58’42.01”N, 6°28’47.84”E.



Landing in downtown St. André should be used mainly. Also one landing-field under the westerly takeoff close to a camping-field.

Landing
1. St. André, zone de Loisir ‘Les Iscles’ (885m).
Access: Very big field at the southern exit of St. André, after the Spar Supermarket follow the signs for Les Iscles. Pass the industrial plants and Camping Les Iscles on your left. Continue straight to the parking and the flying school Aeroglis (windsock).
GPS: 43°57’31.12”N, 6°30’38.61”E

2. Moriez (940m) landing field for PG, just above the N202 Barrême–St.André at the southern exit of Moriez right above the entrance of Camping Le Pastaïre. 
GPS: 43°57’40.00”N, 6°28’37.08”E.

3. The field at La Mure, left of the road, is not an official landing. Ask for further info at Aerogliss.

4. Training hill E of the river for strong winds and training, open to all pilots except when the school is teaching. Behind Camping Les Iscles, go across the bridge and head up. 
GPS: 43°57’24.03”N, 6°30’57.50”E.

The valley-wind can be strong at the middle of the day.

Local paragliderschool offers transportation to take-off, weather-forecast, info and equipment. Located at the main LZ.

The flying is powerful around midday and anabatic in the afternoons. Especially between 11h00 and 17h00 from May until August the wind can increase beyond 40km/h on some days.

In the height of summer the day reaches its best from 15h00–18h00 with incredible distances possible!
http://www.para2000.org/weather/mto-pro-r.html

Taxi de l’Etoile at Moustiers:
Tel. +33 (0)4 9274 6687 
or Cell: +33 (0)60737 3378.

name: St Hilaire du Touvet, Grenoble
description:
The North and South launches cover the range of prevailing winds, although the house thermal out in front can sometimes produce a tailwind on the vast astroturfed south launch. In spring it starts working early in the day and after climbing out from a ratty start above the white cliffs below launch you can relax and pick your route.
In calmer autumnal weather take the two-hour hike up to Dent De Crolles above the town for some high mountain soaring and a float back down to your start point
WHEN TO GO
April, May and June have the best XC weather, but the Coupe Icare is in September.
ALTITUDE
Launch: 900m (Dent des Crolles 2,040m)
Landing:230m

Site de la Coupe Icare, bien protégé.
Deux décos : au tapis en haut du funiculaire, et dans un champ au NE du village (déco Sud).
Atterrissage à Lumbin, sur le bord de la Nationale.
Beaucoup de monde en l'air.
Coupe Icare: http://www.coupe-icare.org/GB_home.html

From pont-du-loup, drive towards tourrettes-sur-loup for 3/4km then turn left at the sign "les courmettes" and drive all the way up. Park at the farm then walk 10min on the 4wd road along the ridge and go at the view point. Hard to take-off as lines easily get tangled in thyme.
The landing field is down in the loup valley, at Vallettes, which is also used in winter from Gourdon.

On the picture you can see Gourdon village and the haut montet ridge
